content.title: 2026 Masters prize money, purse breakdown for Augusta National
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 1:01 p.m. ETThe Masters champion receives a green jacket, a lifetime membership and a significant cash prize.The total purse and the winner's share for the Masters have increased annually since 2020.Rory McIlroy won a record $4.2 million from a $21 million total purse in 2025.Each April at Augusta National, the prize every player chases comes wrapped in green. The Masters champion slips into the sport’s most exclusive jacket, earning the honor of selecting the menu for the Champions Dinner the following year — rites and rituals unlike any others in golf.But the rewards don’t end with symbolism and tradition.The winner also leaves Augusta with a noticeably heavier wallet, collecting the largest slice of the Masters purse. That financial windfall has only grown more substantial in recent years. Since 2020, the total purse has increased annually, a trend that shows no sign of slowing.All of which suggests that the champion of the 2026 Masters will be paid even more handsomely than last year’s winner — whose payout already surpassed what Scottie Scheffler earned the year before. At Augusta, prestige is timeless, but the prize money keeps climbing.2026 Masters winner payoutsThe total prize money for professionals competing in the 2026 Masters Tournament is $22.5 million. The first-place prize of $4.5 million matches the Players Championship as the most for a winner on the PGA Tour. (The U.S. Open hasn't revealed its 2026 first-place prize yet. In 2025, it was $4.3 million.)All pros who missed the Masters cut receive $25,000. Those who made the cut will earn payouts ranging from $55,350, based on final position. McIlroy's winnings were $600,000 more than what Scottie Scheffler took home in 2024 when he won his second green jacket in three years.Here's a look at how much the winner has been paid out every year since 2020:2025 winner's share: $4.2 million (Rory McIlroy)2024 winner's share: $3.6 million (Scottie Scheffler)2023 winner's share: $3.24 million (Jon Rahm)2022 winner's share: $2.7 million (Scottie Scheffler)2021 winner's share: $2.07 million (Hideki Matsuyama)2020 winner's share: $1.8 million (Dustin Johnson)2025 Masters payoutsEach of the top four finishers from last year's Masters Tournament took home over $1 million, with runner-up Justin Rose taking home $2,268,000 himself.
